zh-CN.Web_Settings_Appearance_Description: 画布背景颜色与元素卡片主题
zh-CN.Web_Settings_Writing_Description: 画笔色板、粗细档位与滑条开关
zh-CN.Web_Settings_Shortcuts_Description: 撤销/重做手势与鼠标组合快捷键
zh-CN.Web_Settings_Dock_Description: 在主界面就地编辑底部 Dock
zh-CN.Web_Settings_PaletteCount_Description_Fm: 可设 {0}~{1} 个色块，空格子表示未设置颜色。
zh-CN.Web_Settings_Shortcut_Description: 支持 Ctrl / Alt / Shift 组合；留空表示禁用
zh-CN.Web_Settings_ConflictReminder_Descriptio: 当两个快捷键冲突时给出提醒
zh-CN.Web_Settings_ExportSettings_Description: 导出当前全部设置到 JSON 文件（与桌面版格式兼容）
zh-CN.Web_Settings_ImportSettings_Description: 从 JSON 文件导入并覆盖当前全部设置（忽略未知字段，非法值回落默认）
zh-CN.Web_Settings_Shortcuts_Hint: 撤销与重做不能同时禁用；两者都留空时会自动保留默认的撤销快捷键。
zh-CN.Web_Settings_ThicknessSlider_Hint_Fmt: 滑条模式：画笔粗细在 {0}~{1} 之间连续调整。

en-US.Web_Settings_Appearance_Description: Canvas background color and element card theme
en-US.Web_Settings_Writing_Description: Pen palette, thickness presets and slider switch
en-US.Web_Settings_Shortcuts_Description: Undo/redo shortcuts and mouse gesture combinations
en-US.Web_Settings_Dock_Description: Edit the bottom Dock in place on the main screen
en-US.Web_Settings_PaletteCount_Description_Fm: Between {0} and {1} slots; an empty slot has no color.
en-US.Web_Settings_Shortcut_Description: Supports Ctrl / Alt / Shift combinations; leave empty to disable
en-US.Web_Settings_ConflictReminder_Descriptio: Show a reminder when two shortcuts conflict
en-US.Web_Settings_Version_Description: Numbered separately from the desktop app.
en-US.Web_Settings_ExportSettings_Description: Export all settings to a JSON file (format compatible with the desktop app)
en-US.Web_Settings_ImportSettings_Description: Import and overwrite all settings from a JSON file (unknown fields are ignored, invalid values fall back to defaults)
en-US.Web_Settings_Shortcuts_Hint: Undo and redo cannot both be disabled; when both are left empty the default undo shortcut is kept.
en-US.Web_Settings_ThicknessSlider_Hint_Fmt: Slider mode: pen thickness adjusts continuously between {0} and {1}.
